blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Philippines opened its campaign in the inaugural ASTAF U19 Asian Sepak Takraw Championship with a historic win as the boys doubles team of Gab Silva, Jerald Evangelio and Julian Gamanay swept Iraq, 15-5, 15-5, at Rizal Memorial Coliseum on Thursday. The Mindanao-based trio, all making their international debuts, needed just 20 minutes to secure their first victory in Group A of the tournament presented by the Philippine Sports Commission. The win provided a bright spot for the hosts after the Philippine girls regu team of Renelyn Montero, Jay Ann Balwit and Crestanyl Beganio fell to Vietnam, 8-15, 6-15. READ: […]...
